title: Minimal Matter: Permeable Interior Walls from 3D-Printed Minimal-Surface Clay Modules
summary: Research into permeable interior wall systems assembled from modular, 3D-printed clay components derived from minimal-surface geometry.

title: Prompt-to-Geometry: Exploring Large Language Models for Generative Python Scripting in Architectural Design
summary: An undergraduate research project examining how large language models can support reusable Python scripting and generative architectural design workflows.

title: SteamBot: Computational Methods for Integrated Robotic Bending of Steamed Timber
summary: A computational and robotic fabrication workflow for steam-bending timber members without fixed formwork, connecting material behavior with programmable geometry.

title: Computational Methods for the Analysis of Traditional Safranbolu House Plan Typologies using Generative Adversarial Network Algorithm
summary: Computational analysis of traditional Safranbolu house plans using machine-learning methods to study typological organization, variation, and architectural heritage.

title: Development of Computational Tools for Design Processes of Geometric Pattern-Based Muqarnas
summary: Development of computational methods for analyzing, reconstructing, and generating geometric muqarnas systems as operational architectural design tools.

title: Founding of Digital Design and Fabrication Laboratory
summary: Establishment of an institutional laboratory supporting computational design, digital fabrication, research, and hands-on architectural education.

title: DESIGNHUB-IST Design, Education and Development Center
summary: Research participation in a design, education, and development center connecting academic expertise, creative production, and regional innovation.

title: CAREER: GRAFT — Geometry-Rich Alignment for Foundation-Model Training in Generative Building Design
summary: A research proposal focused on geometry-rich alignment and architectural datasets for training foundation models in generative building design.
